site.title: Forge Prep · Artifacts
site.tagline: Shareable one-pagers, playbooks, and references for the Forge Prep team. Send a link, not an attachment.

artifacts.title: Decouple Math
artifacts.summary: The full illustrated walkthrough making the case for decoupling math placement from grade level — the team-facing version, backed by the NJSLS year-gap and IES practice guide.

artifacts.title: The Decision Playbook
artifacts.summary: How to decide well when the data is cheap — and when it isn't. A mechanism-vs-track-record rule, a named-traps table, and a run-before-you-litigate checklist.

artifacts.title: The Lesson Audit Playbook
artifacts.summary: How we stand behind ~700 AI-written lessons without reading all 700 — the gates, the automated checks, the 4-minute human read, and the maintainer model.

artifacts.title: Fall Math Threads Map
artifacts.summary: What each challenge actually teaches, in lesson order and tagged to the spine — Uniforms, St. Hubert's, and Gardens mapped across grade bands.

artifacts.title: Fall Math — Dependency-Checked Calendar
artifacts.summary: Every math block on one staggered calendar per grade band, each lesson checked against the SAP prerequisite graph so nothing is taught before its prerequisites.

artifacts.title: Fall Math — Prescriptive Edit List
artifacts.summary: Lesson-by-lesson edits for Fall math: every prerequisite either taught in-challenge or flagged as genuine intake, sourced to the SAP prerequisite graph.

artifacts.title: Standard → Exemplar Lesson Lookup
artifacts.summary: Pick a standard (a spine node) and get every IM and Eureka lesson that teaches it. Interactive lookup across Grades 5–8 math.

artifacts.title: Self-Rebalancing Lesson Calendar
artifacts.summary: Drag any lesson to a new day and everything downstream re-solves to keep the scheduling rules true, moving as little as possible. Interactive proof of concept.
